metadata.description: Test marketplace bundling two sibling plugins from one repo: sandbox-mobile (XcodeBuildMCP + iOS skills) and sandbox-web (Playwright MCP + browser skills). Cursor counterpart of the .claude-plugin marketplace.

plugins.name: sandbox-mobile
plugins.description: Mobile sandbox plugin: XcodeBuildMCP + four iOS skills (list-simulators, list-devices, list-schemes, discover-projects).

plugins.name: sandbox-web
plugins.description: Web sandbox plugin: Playwright MCP + two browser skills (page-snapshot, screenshot-page). Sibling to sandbox-mobile; independent versioning and updates.
